title: The Art of Spending Money
caption:
💸 The Art of Spending Money – Morgan Housel

After The Psychology of Money, Morgan Housel asks the other half of the question: once you have money, how do you use it to live a richer life? Short, warm chapters on envy, freedom, status and the quiet joy of spending on what truly matters to you.
